title: [BUG] disable all data augmentation results in unexpected cropping
author: shunmian

comments.author: rwightman
comments.body:
@shunmian that's not augmentation, that's expected cropping. The transforms output a constant image size, it defaults to square unless you provide a different size tuple. You input a non-square image it resizes the shortest size to 224 and then crops center to output 224 x 224. Not sure what else you would expect, this is the default preprocessing expected for most models. Note the scale/ratio args are for training random resize & crop and don't impact things when is_training=False.

If you want the whole image you can specificy `crop_mode='squash'`, but it will distort aspect, or `crop_mode=border` and it will add borders (letterboxing) to achieve target size.
